newsitem.title: USA: Core Industries segments up in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Core Industries segments up in Q3.

text.p: Core Industries Inc said on Monday that record sales and earnings for the fiscal third quarter were due to improvements in each of its three business segments.

"We are very pleased with our record sales and earnings for any quarter and the nine months of fiscal 1997," David Zimmer, president, said in a statement. "For the third quarter, each of our segments grew its earnings over the comparable period last year."

Core reported earnings of $0.44 a share in the third quarter ended May 31, up from $0.34 a year ago. Sales were $76.67 million, up from $63.1 million a year ago. Nine-month earnings were $1.06 a share, up from $0.86 a year ago, and sales were $192.8 million, up from last year's $167.9 million.

Core said its Fluid Controls and Construction Products segment had third quarter sales of $31.3 million, down from $32.7 million a year. Pretax earnings, however, rose to $4.5 million compared with $4.3 million a year ago.

"The Fluid Controls and Construction Products segment delivered higher earnings despite lower sales and earnings at Flow Technologies in Houston," Zimmer said. "Other divisions within the Core Fluid Control Group, especially CMB Industries, posted higher sales and earnings."

The Test Measurement and Control segment had sales of $28.2 million, up from $17.0 million last year, and earnings of $3.0 million, up from $1.7 million a year ago. Core said said the results reflected improvements in its base businesses and the acquisition of Air Gage Co, effective at the beginning of the quarter.
Farm equipment segment sales were $17.0 million, up from $13.4 million, and earnings were $2.2 million, compared with last year's $1.6 million.
